HOMILIA XXVII.

exousia tou polemein pros ten enantioumenen dynamin. nomos gar te tetagmene physei ou keitai; oute gar ho helios, oute ho ouranos kai he ge hypo nomon eisin, hoti tetagmenes physeos ktismata eisin; hothen oute times oute timorias eisin hypokeimena. he gar time kai he doxa to pros to agathon trepomeno hetoimastai. he de geenna kai he timoria te aute metablete physei hetoimastai, he dynamene to kakon ekklinein kai pros to agathon kai to orthon meros neusai. hora, phis auton tetagmenes einai physeos; oukoun ton agathon andra axion epainou ou poieis. ho gar physei aretos kai agathos on ouk estin axios epainou, kan epithymetos e. to gar me proairesei agathon on ouk esti epaineton, kan epithymeton e. ekeinos gar axios epainou, hos te idia spoude, ou chōris agōnos kai pales, to agathon te eleuthera exousia tes proaireseōs periebaleto.

§. XXII. kathaper hotan e

exousia tou polemein pros ten enantiou dynamin. nomos gar te tetagmene physei ou keitai; oute gar ho helios, oute ho ouranos e he ge hypo nomon echontai; hoti tetagmenes physeos ktismata eisin; hothen oute misthou oute timorias eisin hypokeimena. he gar time kai he doxa to pros to agathon trepesthai dynameno hetoimastai; enantia de geenna kai timoria te aute metablete physei hetoimastai, he de dynamene to kakon ekklinein kai pros to agathon kai orthon meros neusai. ide, phis auton tetagmenes einai physeos; oukoun ton agathon andra axion epainou ou kathistas. ho gar physei epieikes kai agathos on ouk estai axios epainou, kaiper epithymetos on. to gar me proairesei agathon on ouk esti epaineton, kaiper epithymetos on. ekeinos gar axios epainou, hos te idia spoude, ou chōris agōnos kai pales, to agathon periballei, te eleuthera boulesei tes proaireseōs agomenos.
